goal: SkillSelectPanel 中的 AED（自动体外除颤器）技能选择卡片

subject.concept: AED 设备示意图，带有电极贴片和闪电符号
subject.symbolism: 心脏除颤、紧急电击复苏、高级急救设备，AED 是公共场所急救的关键设备

style.rendering: 介于扁平和立体之间，有轻微深度感的概念艺术
style.image_tone: 深蓝黑为主，蓝色和警示金色点缀，医学设备风格

layout.image_area: 上半部分约 70% 为 AED 设备示意图
layout.text_area: 下半部分约 30% 预留给文字标题（不渲染文字）
layout.composition: 居中构图，设备展示风格

prompt: A concept art illustration card showing an AED (Automated External Defibrillator) device for VR medical training, depicting a stylized AED unit with its screen displaying a heart rhythm, electrode pads with wires connected to the device, and a small lightning bolt symbol indicating defibrillation, abstract medical equipment diagram style, dark blue-black atmosphere with base colors #1A1A2E and #0D0D1A, blue accent lighting #00B4D8 on the device screen and edges, subtle yellow #FFD700 accent on the lightning symbol for warning, the rendering is between flat and dimensional with slight depth, cold professional medical lighting, the upper 70% shows the AED illustration while the lower 30% is a darker gradient area, 512x384 resolution, centered composition, no text, no UI overlays, no realistic gore, suitable as a skill selection card for VR training
